releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.12 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Resolved inter-episode transition bug where top-left back navigation icon falsely caused episode list to be treated as an ad screen
* Implemented Seamless Fast Flow: removed artificial 30s-90s rest countdown between episodes, applying natural human reaction pacing (1.0s-1.8s)
* Fixed dropped celebration dialog event loop, scheduling immediate 500ms follow-up scan for next episode unlock
* Added Active Auto-Scroll mechanism to reveal below-viewport unlock buttons on episode list
* Verified 100% test pass rate across all 380 unit tests
